hook: What if 6,560 sq mi of the world’s driest desert suddenly bloomed?

sections.voiceover: What if 6,560 sq mi of the world’s driest desert suddenly bloomed?
In 2026, a wildflower bloom covered 6,560 square miles of Chile’s Atacama Desert. How does that size compare with the 1997 record?
But the bloom’s reach is double any previous Atacama flowering.
The bloom covers 6,560 square miles, the largest flowering since 1997. 2026 now holds the Atacama’s flowering record.
6,560 square miles of desert now bloom in color.
